question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

For good
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. “Forever.”

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let’s look at the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase: 
 
• The phrase 'For good' means 'permanently; indefinitely; forever.'
 
• *Example*:
 
 
• *​Sohel left India and settled in America **for good**.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 1 'Forever', which exactly resembles the meaning of the given idiom/ phrase.

 

Correct meaning:__ Forever*.*
